about: Clock times in the phone's / Mac's 12- or 24-hour setting (not the locale's default) and the graph's hour labels, shared by Android (GraphFixtureTest.clock, graph/Clock.kt) and Mac (-graphselftest, Clock in SukraraGraph.swift). Format: ../README.md.

cases.name: en-US, 24 h set, morning: two-digit hour
en-US, 12 h, half past midnight: 12, not 0
es-ES, 24 h, morning: the locale's one-digit hour
es-ES, 12 h set: the locale's day period
